senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אוּץ) [to press, stamp in anger, v.
units: Deut. XXXII, 19,] to be indignant; to be bold; (act. verb) to reject, insult, blaspheme.

<cite ref="Ketubot 8b">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> (ref. to Deut. l. c.) [read:] <he>דור שאבות מְנָאֲצִים לו הקב״ה וכ׳</he> a generation in which the parents insult him, the Lord will &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 945:11">Yalk. Deut. 945</cite> <he>מְנָאֲצִין בו וכ׳</he>.…—
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 320:1">Sifré Deut. 320</cite> <he>מנאצים לפניו</he>, v. <cite ref="N00010"><he>נָאֶה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>כל מי שני׳ לאלהים נעשה זר</he> whoever insults God becomes an outcast (leper).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Ib.</cite> <he>הם נִאֲצוּ אותי</he> they insulted me.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מי שמְנָאֵץ בדברי תורה</he> who makes bold with the words of the Law (blasphemes); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to threaten. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 7 חמשה … מנאץ וכ׳ five things did Pharaoh threaten to do; Yalk. Ex. 249. Mekh. l. c.; Yalk. Ex. 250 היה עומד ומנ׳ אחר וכ׳ stood threatening at the palace &c.; a. e.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 74:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIV</cite>, end <he>עשה בשביל … שמתחרף ומִתְנָאֵץ בעולם</he> do it for the sake of thy great and holy Name which is blasphemed and insulted in the world; a. e.
